title: Word order in a typological sample — word_order
text: True model: family draws word order area's preferences; language keeps probability 0.8 otherwise draws . Postpositions probability 0.92 SOV, 0.5 -dominant-order 0.12 VO languages. Case marking probability 0.7 SOV 0.3 languages. Consonant inventories 6 plus negative binomial count (mean 16, -family variation); vowel inventories 3 plus Poisson count (mean 2.5). Overall, 44% languages SOV, 36% SVO, 6% VSO 14% dominant order, close world-wide proportions WALS (feature 81A). language, family area names figures invented.
